properties.decision:
Anthony, 2026-08-25, accepting a proposed functional grouping put to him with alternatives. **Applied the same day.**

    BEFORE   95 components   depth {1:13, 2:80, 3:2}   span>7: 3  (coherence-loop 28, agent-surface 25, foundation 10)
    AFTER   105 components   depth {1:13, 2:37, 3:55}  span>7: 2  (tool-surface 12 deliberate, foundation 10 out of scope)
             hierarchy_issues 0        multiple_parents 0

⚠️ **THIS PARTIALLY SUPERSEDES `fact:adopt-recovers-depth-cleanly-and-cannot-recover-the-functional-carving`**, which the duplicate guard surfaced and which is the measurement that motivated this work. Its headline reads *"the hand-built functional design violates span of control in 4 places"* — that was true when written this morning (coherence-loop 28, agent-surface 25, reflow2 13, foundation 10) and is **now 2**, of which one is deliberate and one out of scope. **Everything else in that fact still stands**, including its central finding that adopt cannot recover the functional carving, which is exactly why this split was done by hand.

═══ sys:coherence-loop, 28 → 5 ═══

    Finding              7   detect heal hierarchy surprises granularity consumption coverage
    Telling              6   report ility maturity dimensions regions scope
    Evidence             6   verify artifact confirm drift fielded operate
    Change and structure 6   propagate budget structure allocate relate claims
    Across designs       3   compose depends seam

⭐⭐ **SEPARATING FINDING FROM TELLING IS THE OBSERVABILITY CUT, and it is why this grouping and not another.** `dec:reflow2-is-built-for-observability` (accepted hours earlier) says this design is built so its answers never misrepresent what it knows. Observability-driven allocation wants THE INSTRUMENT SEPARATED FROM THE SUBJECT — a part that finds a problem must not be the part that decides how loudly to report it. Fusing detection and reporting is how a green gate over uncovered ground gets built without anybody choosing to. **The quality target was not decoration; it picked the cut.**

Evidence is separate from both because Finding and Telling reason ABOUT THE DESIGN while Evidence reasons about THE WORLD THE DESIGN DESCRIBES — the boundary where as-designed and as-built are allowed to disagree.

═══ sys:agent-surface, 25 → 5 ═══

    Tool surface         12   the twelve tools-* slices
    Serving and transport 6   service main mcp-http proxy shared registry
    Session posture       3   latent sync-debt discover
    Surface shaping       3   dto bulk skills
    Install               1   init

🛑 **THE TOOL SURFACE STAYS AT 12, OVER THE BAND, ON HIS EXPLICIT WORD:** *"leave it at 12 — don't invent a rung."* Those slices are already a partition of ONE surface, cut once by lifecycle phase. Splitting them to reach seven would use span of control as a GENERATOR — the error the open-ladder decision and the whole depth-is-a-consequence argument forbid. **The band said 25 was wrong. It does not say 12 is.**

📌 **AND `Install` IS A SUBSYSTEM OF ONE, KEPT THAT WAY.** It is the only part that writes into a repository that is not reflow2's own; folding it into a bigger box to avoid a group of one would hide the single place where the blast radius leaves this project. Group size is a check on whether a grouping is doing work, never a quota to fill.

═══ HOW THE RUNG WAS MADE, and the alternative rejected ═══

The declared ladder is `part ▸ component ▸ subsystem ▸ system ▸ …` and there is no rung between `subsystem` and `component`. Two ways to make room: DEMOTE the 53 modules to `part`, or PROMOTE the two containers to `system`. **Promotion, because it preserves what every existing node means** — the modules stay components — and changes 2 levels instead of 53.

⚠️ THE COST, STATED: the top tier is now MIXED — 8 subsystems and 2 systems under the Project. That asymmetry is honest rather than accidental: these two really are bigger, holding 84 and 49 of 211 capabilities between them.

🛑 **WHAT THIS DELIBERATELY IS NOT: the module hierarchy adopt recovered.** That trial's top tier was `cmp:crate-reflow2-core` and `cmp:crate-reflow2-mcp` — CRATES. Applying it would have replaced a functional carving with a structural one and overturned `dec:bl83a-functional-decomposition`. A functional over-span wants a functional answer; the module view stays evidence, never a replacement spine. (The scratch graph is gone in any case — the only stores left on disk are from 2026-08-20 and hold the flat pre-nesting version.)

📌 STILL OPEN, surfaced by this split rather than created by it: `cmp:claims` (coordination of parallel work) and `cmp:operate` (deploy/environments) may not belong in the coherence loop at all. Both were placed rather than resolved, and the discomfort is written on `sub:change-and-structure`. `sys:foundation` at 10 children was out of scope and is still over the band.
properties.name: DECIDED — coherence-loop and agent-surface each gain a functional rung; the tool surface stays at 12 rather than inventing one
properties.rationale:
Settled by the user against recorded alternatives on both questions — a broader three-group split and a member-by-member walkthrough for the first, a phase-split of the tool slices and a defer-agent-surface option for the second.

DISTINCT FROM the adopt trial fact the guard surfaced, and the line is clean: that node MEASURED that depth is recoverable from the artifact and that the functional carving is not. This is the DECISION about what the functional rung actually is — which had to be made by hand precisely because that measurement said inspection could not produce it. The fact motivated this; it does not contain it.

Recorded as one decision covering both splits because they share their method and justification: the same ladder problem, the same promotion choice, and the same rule that span of control checks a grouping rather than generating one. Two nodes would duplicate the reasoning and let one drift.

The two groups that break the band — tool surface at 12 and Install at 1 — are argued IN the decision rather than apologised for, because a later reader running span of control will find them and needs to meet the reason rather than re-derive it.
